headline_marked: Flipper Devices Launches [[Busy Bar]] Productivity Display for $199
headline: Flipper Devices Launches Busy Bar Productivity Display for $199
summary: This new gadget helps you set timers, block apps, and display custom messages, aiming to improve focus for remote workers.
details: Flipper Devices, known for its Flipper Zero hacker gadget, has introduced a new productivity-focused device called Busy Bar. It features a 72x16 LED matrix display with 400 nits brightness and 16 million colors, designed to show custom messages, timers, and widgets.

The Busy Bar aims to help users set Pomodoro-style timers and indicate their availability to others, especially useful in work-from-home environments. It also offers app blocking features on iOS and Android, and can display an 'on call' status when integrated with macOS.

Connectivity options include Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and USB. The device is powered by a 3250 mAh battery offering up to eight hours of active use and two weeks of standby. A 15W adapter can fully charge it in one hour.

The Busy Bar is Matter-certified, allowing it to integrate with smart home ecosystems from Amazon, Apple, and Google, enabling automations based on its status. Developers can also customize the device using its open firmware, HTTP API, MQTT, and official Python/TypeScript libraries.

The Busy Bar will be available for purchase next month, starting July 14th in the US, EU, UK, and Canada. The first 3,000 customers can get it for $199, while the regular price will be $249. Flipper Devices also plans to release accessories like wall mounts and screen protectors.
